changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE document_evidence_projection ( tenant_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, project_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, document_revision CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, link_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, node_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, evidence_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, claim_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, value_json JSON NOT NULL, schema_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, schema_manifest_sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, created_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, classification VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,link_id,node_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_document_evidence_identity (tenant_id,project_id,evidence_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,node_id) REFERENCES document_node (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,node_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,evidence_id) REFERENCES evidence_link (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,evidence_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,claim_id) REFERENCES claim (tenant_id,project_id,document_revision,claim_id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id,created_by) REFERENCES tenant_member (tenant_id,user_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs
